User guide

Crossword Helper user guide

For people who want to build crosswords with the Crossword Helper web app. It covers installing the app on a Mac, building a puzzle, and looking up what each control does. It does not cover changing the software; for that, see the contributor documentation.

Autofill is known to be imperfect: it can return entries that are not valid words, and some settings can stop without changing the grid. The guide says so where it matters, and the open issues are listed under "Known Limitations" in the project README.

Once the project is on your computer, this guide also opens as a web page with a page list and the same pictures: open docs/user-guide/site/index.html in your browser.

Start here

  1. Install Crossword Helper on macOS: from the GitHub repository to the app open in your browser.
  2. Your first crossword: build, fill, save and export a small puzzle, step by step.
